messages.author: James Kress
messages.body:
The initial UHF calculation is proceeding smoothly to convergence. However,
the switch to the DFT process causes the SCF to diverge.
I'd suggest you try to set SWOFF to 1.0e-06 to get the UHF to more complete
convergence before it changes to UDFT.
Jim
